what: Apple Silicon (M1 Pro) real-input skirmish soak of the OpenAL shim's queued end-of-sample callback delivery on the fixed shim (#153), mirroring audio-callback-soak.json. A session-only LLDB probe (the #149 method: memory reads of the shim mirror and the Vulkan owned_* vectors, breakpoints on the three engine EOS callbacks with per-hit thread classification in Python, NO OpenAL/AIL_* function evaluation from the debugger) attached to the strict-link arm64 binary from scripts/native-build.py. Sound effects and music on; OpenAL Soft CoreAudio backend; MacBook Pro Speakers.
platform: macOS 26.x arm64 (Apple M1 Pro), Apple clang 21.0.0, MoltenVK 1.4.2, OpenAL Soft CoreAudio backend
binary: scripts/native-build.py --level 1 --level 2 --level 3 --level 4 --with-shims --strict-link --build-dir build/native-macos-arm64-w12: 981/981 objects, 0 undefined, strict link exit 0, Mach-O 64-bit arm64
input: real OS input (mouse clicks and Escape key delivered by the OS, no synthetic engine events): main menu -> SKIRMISH -> PLAY GAME (Alpine Assault, USA vs one Easy AI, AmericaSuperWeaponGeneral); pause/resume by Escape
mission_in_game_clock_at_quit: 00:23:16 (logic time; the in-game clock advances per logic frame)
mission_utc: about 18:40:00 (first mission sample 18:40:26 at logic frame 763) to 19:13:40 (Escape -> EXIT GAME)
probed_window_utc: 18:40:26 to 19:06:28 (two attach windows: soak-a 30 min from 18:29:55 incl. menu, soak-b 10 min from 19:01:09)
owned_vector_unit: elements: (finish - start) / sizeof(void*) over each std::vector's own begin/end words

samples.note: inside the paused stretch: logic frame frozen, render ring still 30, all voices stopped

logic_fps_note: Under this probe every EOS callback is a breakpoint stop (about 20-45 per second), which costs logic frames; Wave 11 measured 29.85 logic FPS on this Mac with no breakpoints. The render ring (engine fpsHistory) sat at 29.5-30.5 in quiet intervals and shows 13-49 excursions where the probe stopped and resumed the process.

callbacks.counting_method: LLDB breakpoints on setSampleCompleted / set3DSampleCompleted / setStreamCompleted; thread id of each hit compared with the main thread in Python; first 25 stacks per callback sampled
callbacks.sampled_stack_shape: setXSampleCompleted <- OpenALAudio::deliverCompletions <- OpenALAudio::ApiCall::~ApiCall <- AIL_* (AIL_set_3D_orientation from MilesAudioManager::setDeviceListenerPosition, AIL_stream_loop_count from MilesAudioManager::hasMusicTrackCompleted) on the main thread
callbacks.engine_handlers: not counted (a continuously active deliverCompletions / notifyOfAudioCompletion / startNextLoop breakpoint cost ~19 s per stop and dropped the game to ~6 FPS; only the three EOS callbacks were counted)

quit_path.route: Escape -> EXIT GAME -> YES -> score screen EXIT -> skirmish menu MAIN MENU -> EXIT GAME, with plain lldb attached to observe the exit status (no expression evaluation)

output_device.tool: standalone Swift AudioObjectGetPropertyData query outside the game
output_device.name: MacBook Pro Speakers
output_device.shim_open: alcOpenDevice(nullptr) + alcCreateContext(device, nullptr): no frequency/channel/refresh attributes requested; effective OpenAL context format UNMEASURED (reading it needs alcGetIntegerv, which the probe must not call)

human_audibility.label: HUMAN AUDIBILITY, Mac, live
human_audibility.defect: constant crackle/pop across main menu (music only) and skirmish
human_audibility.recorded_output: UNMEASURED: no ffmpeg/BlackHole/aggregate loopback on this Mac; a ScreenCaptureKit system-audio capture recorded a system sound at -26.7 dBFS peak but the game's output as digital silence (-120 dBFS in every 0.5 s window), so the capture route did not reach the game's CoreAudio client

verdict: pass (callback thread affinity and >=20 min soak); defect: constant crackle, human-observed, mechanism INFERRED
